name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-07-21, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
